<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2015/06/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>everythingpowertoys</id>
    <version>_VERSION_</version>
    <title>EverythingPowerToys</title>
    <authors>Lin Yu-Chieh (Victor)</authors>
    <owners>linycv</owners>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/lin-ycv/EverythingPowerToys</projectUrl>
    <iconUrl>https://rawcdn.githack.com/lin-ycv/EverythingPowerToys/v0.60.1/Images/Everything.light.png?min=1</iconUrl>
    <licenseUrl>https://github.com/lin-ycv/EverythingPowerToys/blob/main/LICENSE</licenseUrl>
    <requireLicenseAcceptance>true</requireLicenseAcceptance>
    <description>Everything integration for PowerToys Run</description>
    <summary>Everything integration for PowerToys Run</summary>
    <tags>everythingpowertoys everything powertoys search ept powertoys-run-plugin powertoys-run</tags>
    <bugTrackerUrl>https://github.com/lin-ycv/EverythingPowerToys/issues</bugTrackerUrl>
    <packageSourceUrl>https://github.com/lin-ycv/EverythingPowerToys/releases/tag/v_VERSION_</packageSourceUrl>
    <projectSourceUrl>https://github.com/lin-ycv/EverythingPowerToys</projectSourceUrl>
    <releaseNotes>https://github.com/lin-ycv/EverythingPowerToys/releases/tag/v_VERSION_</releaseNotes>
    <dependencies>
      <dependency id="everything" version="1.4.11023" />
      <!--<dependency id="powertoys" version="_VERSION_" />-->
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>

stop-process -Name "PowerToys"

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop';
$toolsDir   = "$(Split-Path -parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Definition)"
$url        = '_URL_'

$packageArgs = @{
  packageName   = $env:ChocolateyPackageName
  unzipLocation = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Microsoft\\PowerToys\\PowerToys Run\\Plugins\\"
  url           = $url

  softwareName  = 'EverythingPowerToys*'

  checksum      = '_CRC_'
  checksumType  = 'sha256'
}

Install-ChocolateyZipPackage @packageArgs
